input.text: Build a single-file HTML/CSS/JS production-style AI agent operations dashboard using mock data. Include KPI overview, labeled quality and operations trend charts, sortable and filterable runs table, right-side selected run detail panel with trace evidence, anomaly alerts, dark mode, responsive mobile layout, and visible loading, empty, error, partial, selected, and stale states. Prioritize fast 5-10 second scanning, strong visual hierarchy, consistent components, realistic happy-path plus failure-path data, and a complete valid HTML document.
